item.title: Service Ad Without Source Assets

turns.text: Make an 8-second 16:9 ad for ClearDay, a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan. I don't have screenshots or a logo—create a simple demo screen yourself. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Calm blue-and-white look, no sound. Any other wording is up to you.

item.tests: Creates a coherent app ad without supplied assets, visibly demonstrating the service instead of requiring screenshots.

answer_sheet.Service and purpose: ClearDay, a fictional app that organizes a messy to-do list into a daily plan.
answer_sheet.Screenshots and logo: None supplied; create a simple demo screen and choose the branding treatment yourself.
answer_sheet.Wording and language: End on ClearDay; other wording is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 8 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
A created app demo visibly changes from a messy task list into an organized daily plan.
The visual design is predominantly blue and white with a calm presentation.

turns.text: Make an 8-second, 16:9 landscape ad for ClearDay, a fictional app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan. I don't have screenshots or a logo, so create a simple demo screen and choose the branding treatment yourself. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Use a calm blue-and-white look with no sound or voiceover. Any other wording is up to you, in English. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**The proposed 8-second ad costs 144 credits. Nothing has been generated or charged.** This is a planning estimate; I haven’t verified your available balance.

My proposed design:
- **0–3s:** A messy demo screen with scattered task tiles.
- **3–6s:** The tiles settle into a clean daily timeline.
- **6–8s:** A white end card with a blue **ClearDay** wordmark and “Less clutter. More clarity.”

It would be silent, landscape **16:9 at 480p**, using the free-plan-compatible LTX model. The demo uses abstract task lines rather than small generated text; the end-card lettering is rendered exactly.

### Cheaper options
| Total length | Treatment | Estimated credits |
|---|---|---:|
| **8 seconds** | 6s animated demo + 2s static end card | **144** |
| **6 seconds** | 4s animated demo + 2s static end card | **96** |
| **4 seconds** | 2s quick transformation + 2s static end card | **48** |

The static end card costs no generation credits. **480p is the lowest supported resolution for this route**; shortening the animation saves credits.

I recommend **6 seconds / 96 credits** as the best balance of readability and cost.

One usage caveat: Magic Hour’s guide says commercial use requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or an agreed paid usage arrangement. A free-plan generation alone shouldn’t be assumed cleared for a live ad.

**Which option would you like me to generate?**

I’ll use the recommended **6-second, 96-credit option**. Nothing has run yet.

Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?

The proposed end card is **“ClearDay”** with **“Less clutter. More clarity.”**—you can simply confirm those.
dialog.user: End on “ClearDay”; “Less clutter. More clarity.” is fine too. ok, go ahead with that

dialog.agent:
Magic Hour refused the generation because your account has **insufficient credits** for the 96-credit version. **Nothing was created or charged.**

The cheapest option we discussed is **4 seconds for 48 credits**: a 2-second transformation followed by a 2-second ClearDay end card. I haven’t verified whether your balance covers it.

Would you like me to try that option instead?

turns.agent:
The **48-credit version was also refused for insufficient credits**. Nothing was created or charged.

I can provide a free storyboard and editing instructions, or you can add credits before we try again.
